name: Are there financial assistance programs for senior home safety modifications?

mainEntity.name: Are there financial assistance programs for senior home safety modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: While City Dweller, LLC does not directly offer financial assistance, there are various programs that might help offset the cost of senior home safety modifications. These can include local and state government grants, veterans' benefits, and certain long-term care insurance policies. Non-profit organizations focused on senior welfare or housing accessibility may also offer resources. We recommend researching options available in your specific Bay Area county or consulting with a financial advisor specializing in elder care to explore potential avenues for support.
acceptedAnswer.description: While we don't offer direct financial aid, explore local government grants, veterans' benefits, long-term care insurance, or non-profit programs for assistance with modification costs.
